name: GrailLayout
description: a responsive web design structure with header, left aside, center main, right aside, footer
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: Renders no implicit landmark — the wrapper is a generic container
The contained `<header>`, `<aside>`, `<main>`, and `<footer>` elements provide page-level landmarks
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `children`: slot (required) -- layout section elements to render inside the container
`...restProps`: unknown -- additional attributes spread onto the `<div>` element
